_doc: Demo45 thermal plan (firmware DUAL; DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §3) — same format as Demo44 (tools/thermal/plan_sim.py). az: 0 front, -90 LEFT ear, +90 RIGHT ear. 'set' = ambient sources by name (level 0 removes), 'pulse' = [kind, az, level, rise, hold, fade], 'sweep' = [kind, az0, az1, secs, level]. Every source is physical and visible; the bronze mirror's light and the ring of light in the pond have NO temperature (rule card).

@mirror.why: the museum's bronze mirror flashes: light only, no temperature

@plunge.why: you drop through the ice into the frozen lotus pond: icy water on your skin and ears = the COLD PEAK, both ears

@pulled_out.why: Saku hauls you out (hold): out of the water, still soaked in the winter air

@cloak.why: his dry cloak around you: the wet cold drops, the cloth warms both sides a little

@chamber.why: the prince's chamber: snowy lattice window on the LEFT, big bronze brazier on the RIGHT

@stoke.why: he throws charcoal and pine on the brazier: the flames leap up front-right = the WARM PEAK

@warmer_right.why: the bronze hand-warmer held to your RIGHT cheek

@terrace.why: the open star terrace: night wind from the LEFT (gusting), a bronze incense burner on the RIGHT

@by_incense.why: he seats you beside the incense burner: it is close to your RIGHT cheek now, out of the wind

@fan_right.why: silent: his feather fan sweeps the incense warmth away and fans cold night air across your RIGHT cheek — right ear warm → cool in < 1 s

@lean_left.why: he moves to your LEFT ear, into the north wind: his warm whisper + the cold wind on the same ear

@corridor.why: the moonlit corridor: cold night air both sides

@torches.why: assassins' torches pass along the garden path beyond the railing, LEFT → RIGHT, a few metres away (hold your breath)

@sunrise.why: dawn at the pond: the sun in front, the morning chill

showcase.fast_switch: terrace: @by_incense (right warm .5 + his voice) → @fan_right (right cool .7, incense gone) in a silent moment between s06 and s07
showcase.peak: pond: @plunge cold water .92 both ears; chamber: @stoke flame .88 front-right
showcase.direction: chamber: window LEFT cool / brazier RIGHT warm; corridor: torches sweep LEFT → RIGHT; terrace: wind LEFT / incense RIGHT
showcase.same_ear_dual: terrace s08: Shion's whisper at the LEFT ear in the north wind; pond k08: left-ear whisper while still wet-cold
